name: devdash-agents
description: Calls the locally installed Copilot CLI and presents its answers as structured Markdown.

command.description: Empty for id=local; otherwise a connection command accepting -- and a remote command. May be repeated across machine entries.

repositoriesPath.description: Absolute repositories root on this machine.

modelsPath.description: Absolute model sources, downloads and exports root on this machine.

devdashAgents.execution.description: Machines and single-model workers, edited in Settings. Null migrates legacy defaults. Each new session selects a worker and an execution machine and saves an immutable assignment.

devdashAgents.cliPath.description: Path to your installed Copilot CLI executable. It is executed directly, not through a shell.

devdashAgents.model.description: Copilot model ID, chosen in the Settings panel. Empty uses the CLI default.

devdashAgents.localModelPath.description: Local GenAI model directory, Transformers checkpoint directory, or Hugging Face model ID (model or owner/model). Choose in Settings to prepare and save a GenAI export; checkpoint preparation requires Python model-builder dependencies.

devdashAgents.localWorkerPath.description: Path to an external native worker, including NPU-enabled builds. By default, use the development worker, then the platform VSIX's bundled CPU or CUDA worker, then devdash-genai-worker on PATH. Executed directly without a shell.

command.description: Connection command run without a shell and followed by -- and the remote command, for example: az ssh vm --ip <ip-address> --subscription <id>.

workerPath.description: Native worker executable on the remote machine.

modelPath.description: Absolute remote model directory containing genai_config.json.

repositoriesPath.description: Absolute remote directory containing the repositories under their local folder names.

devdashAgents.remoteMachines.description: Remote machines that can run local models and their tools, edited in the Settings panel.

devdashAgents.remoteMachine.description: Name of the remote machine running local workers and tools, chosen in the Settings panel. Empty uses this computer.

devdashAgents.localDeviceId.description: Preferred local provider device ID. -1 selects automatically; the Settings panel lists discovered devices.

enumDescriptions: Prefer CUDA when available, then another available provider.
Use CUDA; fail explicitly if unavailable or incompatible.
Use a supported NPU; fail explicitly if unavailable or incompatible.
devdashAgents.localProvider.description: Preferred local execution provider, chosen in the Settings panel. Only explicitly opened local sessions use the native worker; Copilot sessions are unchanged.

devdashAgents.approvedUrlOrigins.description: Remembered URL roots approved for reading (scheme, hostname and optional port, for example https://example.com). Applies across repositories. Remove an entry to require approval again. HTTPS GitHub file reads are automatically approved.

devdashAgents.requestTimeoutMinutes.description: Maximum total duration of a Copilot operation in minutes, including tools and permission waits. Changes apply to subsequent operations, including in existing sessions.

devdashAgents.workerIdleMinutes.description: Stop a worker after this many minutes without any running request, freeing its memory. Local model sessions stay open and reload the model on their next request (KV caches are lost); Copilot sessions are closed with their transcript kept and continue with Resume. 0 never stops idle workers.

scripts.coverage: npm run compile && c8 --all --src dist/src --include=dist/src/** --reporter=lcov --reporter=text --reports-dir=build/coverage/typescript node --test dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test
